_comment: Single source of truth for per-(product,env) VPC /16 allocations. The second octet (10.<net>.0.0/16) must be UNIQUE across every stack so future VPC peering / Transit Gateway / shared-services connectivity never collides. init.sh reads this to reserve the next free octet when scaffolding a new product; CI can assert no stack uses an octet absent from here. Renumbering a live VPC is destructive, so existing entries are frozen.

reserved_bands.products: 10-89  (each product-env takes one octet; product RDS/ECS only — VPC/ALB now shared via runtime)

runtime-prod.note: shared prod VPC+ALB+cache; applied at launch

rally-develop.note: per-product dev VPC — destroyed after cutover to runtime-dev

rally-prod.note: per-product prod VPC — superseded by runtime-prod

opshub-develop.note: per-product dev VPC — destroyed after cutover to runtime-dev

opshub-prod.note: per-product prod VPC — superseded by runtime-prod

next_free_hint: First unused octet in 10-89 (currently 11). init.sh should pick the lowest free value and append two entries (<product>-develop, <product>-prod) before scaffolding.
